mapper.sql: REPORT_ID AS reportId, ORG_MSTR_CODE AS regionCode, ORG_CODE AS districtCode, DATE_FORMAT(ACTIVITY_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS reportDate, SLOT_CODE AS slotCode, REPORT_ROLE AS reportRole, REPORT_TOKEN AS token, REPORT_ENC AS payload, DATE_FORMAT(SYS_MUSR_DTTM, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s.%fZ') AS updatedAt
mapper.select: SELECT FROM AFTRPT ORDER BY ACTIVITY_DATE DESC, SLOT_CODE, REPORT_ROLE, REPORT_ID DESC LIMIT #{filter.size} OFFSET #{filter.offset}
mapper.sql: LIB_ID, ORG_MSTR_CODE, ORG_CODE, ACTIVITY_DATE, SLOT_CODE, REPORT_ROLE, REPORT_TOKEN, REPORT_ENC, SYS_RUSR_ID, SYS_RUSR_DTTM, SYS_MUSR_ID, SYS_MUSR_DTTM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AFTRPT () VALUES (#{libraryId}, #{regionCode}, #{districtCode}, #{date}, #{slot}, 'PARTICIPANT', #{token}, #{payload}, #{accountId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{accountId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))

INSERT INTO AFTRPT () VALUES (#{libraryId}, #{regionCode}, #{districtCode}, #{date}, #{slot}, 'ORGANIZER', #{token}, #{payload}, #{accountId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), #{accountId}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE REPORT_TOKEN = VALUES(REPORT_TOKEN), REPORT_ENC = VALUES(REPORT_ENC), SYS_MUSR_ID = VALUES(SYS_MUSR_ID), SYS_MUSR_DTTM = VALUES(SYS_MUSR_DTTM)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM AFTRPT AND REPORT_ID = #{id} AND REPORT_ROLE = 'PARTICIPANT'
